shots.name: k1
shots.prompt: Wide shot of a small cinema lobby in the evening. Mia, a young woman in a mustard-yellow jacket with her dark curly hair in a low bun and a small canvas tote bag, walks up to the wooden box-office counter, seen from the side; behind the counter the clerk, a woman in a navy uniform with her black hair in a low bun and a blank round badge, looks up with a friendly smile. Warm brass wall lamps glow; the framed posters on the green wall are completely blank. Vertical composition.

Warm brass lamp light on their faces, blank framed posters softly blurred behind. Vertical composition.

shots.prompt: Use the reference image for the characters and the setting: keep the same faces, hair, clothes, colours and lighting.
